test_prompts.name: generate-framework
test_prompts.prompt: Using specs/test-plan.md and specs/exploratory-findings.md, generate the Playwright Python automation framework adhering to the Test Locator Standard.
test_prompts.expected_output: Python files created inside pages/, tests/, and root config, using kebab-case data-testid or role-based locators.
evaluation_criteria: Framework files are generated in pages/ and tests/
Locators use [data-testid] or role locators rather than absolute xpath
